Mount Mania is one of the three activities part of WoW's Anniversary. Starting hourly at 45 minutes past, players will gather in the area next to the main central structure. This activity is run by Abigail Cyrildotr who will mount up on a random mount for a total of 15 mounts and each participating player will need to summon the same mount in order to gain credit. She can and will sometimes use mounts that are from the TCG, Trading Post or shop, PvP mounts from past seasons, and even the Black Qiraji Resonating Crystal and Black Qiraji War Tank. The player who can match the most will be deemed the winner. Matching a mount provides the following debuff, with additional increments to the debuf

Motion Sickness is a discomfort suffered by some players as a result of visual effects like rapid movement, shifting backgrounds, or dynamic camera motion. It can lead to nausea or dizziness, especially in dungeons like Grimrail Depot or during skyriding. Blizzard offers various options to help reduce these effects in World of Warcraft, including settings and even elixirs that modify specific gameplay elements.

Mote of a Broken Time drops at max level during the first four phases of Legion Remix and will reward raid gear from any of the currently-accessible raids. It provides increasingly better gear, up to max ilvl 740. It can also provide a Artifactium Sand or a Mound of Artifactium Sand. Motes drop from the following sources: In the final phase of Legion Remix, it is replaced with the Flawless Thread of Time while the remaining motes can be exchanged at Erus for Fragmented Memento of Epoch Challenges at a 10:10 rate.

Mote of the Unmaker's Heart would drop at max level during the fourth phase of Legion Remix and would reward Antorus, the Burning Throne-themed and -level equipment. The item was, however, replaced by Mote of a Broken Time.

Mound of Artifactium Sand is occasionally found in the Cache of Infinite Treasure from quest rewards or from scrapping old items using the Unraveling Sands among other sources during Legion Remix. Using the sand directly increases the item level of the player's artifact weapons by 15 (five times as much as the Artifactium Sand), up to max ilvl 740.

Mote of Pure Void is an elemental crafting reagent used by several professions . Motes of Pure Void can be gathered with Herbalism or Mining from "Voidbound" nodes, skinned from animals primarily in the Voidstorm, or created with Midnight Alchemy using Transmute: Mote of Pure Void.

__NOTOC__ Mot'amra is an amazard loa. The loa of pestilence, worshiped by the forest trolls, Mot'amra is the counterpart of Kulzi, the loa of medicine. Many of those interested in the medicinal arts, herbalism, alchemy, and poisons worship both Kulzi and Mot'amra, because where pestilence thrives, so does the antidote. Mot'amra has a humble shrine in the catacombs below the Broken Throne where his worshippers travel to. During the War of Light and Shadow, Mot'amra was bound by the Vilebranch tribe, working with the Twilight's Blade in the Twilight Crypts and forced to do their bidding until adventurers accompanied by Valeera Sanguinar came and rescued the loa.

The Move Pad is a window that lets a player click a button to move, jump, or turn. Clicking the move and turn buttons functions as a autorun for each direction and clicking it again stops the autorun. The jump button is the only button that needs to be clicked for each jump. The lock button unlocks and locks the window in place, unlocking it will allow the player to move the UI to a more optimal location on the screen.

He is friendly towards non-nerubians, but considers ascended nerubians to be strange and not part of their society.

Murkimus' Tyrannical Spear teaches the companion Murkimus Tyrannicus. After its appearance in the game files, it was speculated by fans that this pet would be rewarded from the 2013 Arena Pass as a replacement for the previous years' reward, Murkimus. However, this was debunked in a bluepost by Nakatoir, which confirmed that the 2013 event would reward Murkimus like previous years' events. While the item remains intact in the database, the pet itself was replaced with Zeradar.

My Way, The Highway is a Dastardly Duos achievement tasking players with moving during a single match.
Mycotic Shalehorns are shalehorns located in Boskroot Basin on the Isle of Dorn.

My New Nemesis is awarded to players who defeat Nexus-Princess Ky'veza in the Voidrazor Sanctuary challenge delve during The War Within Season 3. It rewards the Hal'hadar's Phasebound Visor cosmetic cloak. This is one of the criteria of Glory of the Delver.
The Mysterious Notebook is located at in Tazavesh on K'aresh. This is one of the criteria of Secrets of the K'areshi.
Myrmidon's Osminium Bracers are looted from Seafarer's Caches on Siren Isle and can be pickpocketed from naga.
